metric_notes.Goal: existing FORWARD reward function applied to predicted final waypoint
metric_notes.TMC: provisional proxy equal to A-to-T action/trajectory consistency; R-to-A is only scored when think contains an explicit directional intent
metric_notes.Unsup: not computed: no validated ground-truth support ontology for arbitrary generated claims
metric_notes.scene_reference: category keyword grounding against annotated BEV object types; pilot heuristic, not human-reviewed
metric_notes.ADE_common: mean ADE over samples with successfully parsed six-point trajectory; paired common subset must be reported for fair ablations
metric_notes.ADE_worstcase: parse failures receive a fixed 10 m penalty; sensitivity analysis with alternative penalties is recommended
